turns.text: I've got the basic structure set up, but I've run into some issues with token refresh.
turns.zh: 基本结构我已经搭好了，但 token 刷新这块遇到了一些问题。

turns.text: Sometimes the tokens are expiring before they should.
turns.zh: 有时候 token 会提前过期，本来不该那么早的。

turns.text: I think I need to dig deeper into our JWT library.
turns.zh: 我觉得我得再深入看看我们用的 JWT 库。

turns.text: Do you need any help with that?
I might need to discuss further with Alex's team.
turns.zh: 我可能得再跟 Alex 他们团队讨论一下。

turns.text: He's worked with this library before.
You've cleared up all other information about this ticket, right?
turns.zh: 这个 ticket 其他信息你都确认清楚了吧？
